turns.say: The alert says the webhook answers 500 when the token file is empty. Reading the receiver first.

tool.title: read {{cwd}}/src/token.js
tool.output:
6:	const token = readFileSync(file, "utf8").trim();
7:	if (token === "") throw new Error("token file is empty");

report.summary: loadToken throws on an empty token file and the webhook handler turns every throw into a 500.
report.rootCause: src/token.js throws "token file is empty" for an empty token file, and the catch in src/webhook.js answers 500 instead of rejecting the request.

hypotheses.statement: An empty token file makes loadToken throw, and the handler maps the throw to a 500

evidence.observation: loadToken throws when the trimmed token is empty.
handlePrometheus catches any error from loadToken and writes a 500.

nextSteps.title: Answer 401 or 503 when the token file is empty, and alert on the empty file itself
nextSteps.detail: The throw is at src/token.js:7 and the 500 at src/webhook.js:11.
